ValidationRule.description: Lets the foundry know if this opportunity is ready to sample.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Ready_to_Sample__c, ''), ISNEW(), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation/Review'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must indicate if the Opportunity is ready to Sample to move to Negotiation stage.
